notes:
Account summary: Northstar Media Labs (streaming + short-form content personalization). Evaluating Redwood Dedicated to replace an internal inference fleet that's cost-inefficient at scale. Primary goal: stable low-latency live-captioning + high-throughput embedding/reranking for realtime recommendations.

Key asks from customer (high-level):
- Throughput guarantees for peak streaming events (concerts) — target sustained: ~3M tokens/hour across region, burst to 5M tokens/hour for 30 min.
- Latency SLO: p95 <= 120ms for <4k context chat/stream captions; p95 <= 250ms for 32k summarization jobs.
- Reserved GPU planning: need a predictable commit for capacity (expecting 4-8 x H100 80GB class equivalents per region, EU and NA).
- Model/quality constraints: prefer open models (Llama2-family and Redwood-curated 34B/70B variants). Must validate Q4/nf4 quantization profiles for quality.
- KV cache & batching: want guidance on prefix KV cache (session affinity for live viewers) and batching policies that don't increase caption latency.

Sales/technical thread highlights:
- 2026-02-18 kickoff w/ AE + SE + Head of AI (fireflies ff_2026-02-18_nsml_intro_43892). SE ran first micro-benchmarks (Mariana) against 34B-quant (nf4) config. Observed ~95ms p95 at 2k context, throughput ~1.8M tokens/hr per 2x H100 equivalent.
- 2026-02-25 POC day: end-to-end demo with live stream ingest. Noted KV-cache warm-up effect: first 60s slow, steady-state meets latency SLO. Customer asks for pre-warming options.
- 2026-03-03 Security questionnaire submitted (SOC2 + SSO entries). Legal opened SEC-3391 for data residency details.
- 2026-03-06 Stress test scheduled: SE ran long-context (32k) summarization; latency spikes observed when multiple large contexts run concurrently. Preliminary mitigation: aggressive batching thresholds + dedicated KV shard per session.
- 2026-03-09 Pricing/commit chat: finance pushing for blended unit cost target; Redwood proposed reserved 6 H100s (NA) + 4 H100s (EU) with burst pool. Customer requests firm SLA credits for latency violations.

Model-specific tuning notes (SE recommendations):
- Recommended baseline models: Redwood-34B-chat (nf4) for most workloads; Redwood-70B-chat (int8) for highest-fidelity summarization where latency allowance higher.
- Quantization profiles to validate: nf4 (q4_nf4), q8_0 for embeddings, fallback int8 for long-context ops. Need comparison matrix showing quality delta on NSML prompt suite.
- Context length planning: 4k for live-captioning (keeps KV small), 32k for episodic summarization. Memory budgeting suggests 6 H100s to maintain 32k context at target throughput.
- Batching settings: continuous-batching with max_delay 8ms for caption streams; larger batch windows (20-40ms) for background summarization. Enable dynamic_batching per route.
- KV cache design: session-affinity on dedicated KV nodes; pre-warm option (pre-cache top-1000 prefixes per show) to avoid initial warm-up penalty.

Requested artifacts from Redwood engineering:
- Detailed dedicated sizing calc (tokens/sec -> GPU mapping) with assumptions and safety factor. (Drive: nsml-dedicated-sizing-v2.pdf)
- Quantization quality report vs FP16 on NSML prompt set (separate eval run).
- Draft SLA with latency SLO definitions and credit matrix for p95/p99 misses.
